name: parse a tree -F directory listing into a nested structure with named leaves and special characters
definition: Interpret the box-drawing indentation and trailing markers of a tree listing to recover the exact nested directory and file layout, including filenames with spaces/special characters.
failure_mode: Mis-parsed indentation/special chars yield a differing regenerated listing

name: parse and aggregate a pcap into network flows
definition: read a .pcap capture, parse the packets, and aggregate packet-level records into distinct flow records (sorted, deduped, with timing fields).
failure_mode: unaggregated or misconstituted flows don't match the expected sample-flow values

name: parse binary header and section-header tables from an ELF file
definition: Read ELF header fields (raw data size, endianness, field offsets) and enumerate section headers to locate the data-carrying sections.
failure_mode: Wrong offsets/endianness yield addresses differing from the reference.

name: parse cli args and write documented output formats
definition: accept the specified option flags for particle count, position-file, summary-file, and thread count and write position/summary files with the defined header/row layouts, plus a specified stdout line shape.
failure_mode: reordered lines or a wrong header/count/convention fail the output-format parsing checks
